The preceding PATH/PROCTITLE record shows `/usr/bin/rm` being run on `/root/README.txt`, suggesting deletion of a file in root's home directory. Running as root, with the obfuscated shell invocation and a file deletion of a user-facing file, points toward malicious activity.
